subject: Gastroenterology
content: Gastroenterology focuses on prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of disorders affecting the gastrointestinal tract, liver, biliary system, and pancreas.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The digestive system processes food, absorbs nutrients and water, and eliminates waste through coordinated activity of the gastrointestinal tract and accessory organs.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The esophagus is a muscular tube that transports swallowed material from the pharynx to the stomach.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The stomach stores ingested food and participates in mechanical and chemical digestion before contents pass into the small intestine.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The small intestine is the major site for digestion and absorption of nutrients and includes the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The large intestine absorbs water and electrolytes and forms and stores fecal material before elimination.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The liver performs metabolic, synthetic, storage, detoxification, and bile-producing functions and receives blood from both the hepatic artery and portal vein.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile and releases it into the biliary tract in response to digestive signals.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The pancreas has exocrine functions that support digestion and endocrine functions that regulate metabolism, including blood glucose.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The stomach secretes acid and other substances that contribute to digestion and help create an environment for processing food.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: The small intestine absorbs carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, and water through specialized epithelial surfaces.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Peristalsis consists of coordinated gastrointestinal contractions that propel luminal contents through the digestive tract.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Gastroesophageal reflux disease occurs when reflux of stomach contents causes troublesome symptoms or complications.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Common symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux include heartburn and regurgitation, although other symptoms may occur.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Chronic reflux can be associated with complications involving the esophagus, including erosive injury and Barrett esophagus.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Peptic ulcer disease involves mucosal ulceration in the stomach or proximal duodenum and is commonly associated with Helicobacter pylori infection or NSAID exposure.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Helicobacter pylori infection can cause chronic gastric inflammation and contributes to peptic ulcer disease and gastric cancer risk.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs can impair gastrointestinal mucosal protection and increase the risk of ulcers and gastrointestinal bleeding.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Gastritis refers to inflammation of the gastric mucosa and can have infectious, medication-related, autoimmune, or other causes.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Crohn disease is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease that can affect any part of the gastrointestinal tract and often has a relapsing course.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease primarily affecting the colon and rectum.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Inflammatory bowel disease can cause abdominal pain, diarrhea, rectal bleeding, fatigue, weight loss, and other systemic manifestations.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Irritable bowel syndrome is a disorder of gut-brain interaction characterized by recurrent abdominal pain associated with altered bowel habits.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome can include abdominal pain, bloating, diarrhea, constipation, or alternating bowel patterns.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Celiac disease is an immune-mediated disorder triggered by gluten exposure in genetically susceptible individuals and causes intestinal mucosal injury.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Damage to the small intestinal mucosa in celiac disease can impair absorption of nutrients and contribute to deficiencies.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Viral hepatitis is inflammation of the liver caused by hepatitis viruses and can lead to acute or chronic liver disease.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Hepatitis B virus infection can cause acute and chronic liver disease, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Hepatitis C virus infection can become chronic and may lead to cirrhosis and liver cancer if untreated.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Cirrhosis is advanced chronic liver disease characterized by fibrosis and architectural distortion that can impair liver function and portal blood flow.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Portal hypertension is increased pressure within the portal venous system and is commonly associated with advanced chronic liver disease.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Hepatic encephalopathy is a brain dysfunction associated with severe liver dysfunction or portosystemic shunting and can produce cognitive and neurological changes.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Ascites is abnormal accumulation of fluid within the peritoneal cavity and is a common complication of advanced cirrhosis.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Hepatocellular carcinoma is the most common primary malignant tumor of the liver and often develops in the setting of chronic liver disease or cirrhosis.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Gallstones are solid deposits that form in the gallbladder and may be asymptomatic or cause biliary pain and complications.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Cholecystitis is inflammation of the gallbladder and is commonly associated with obstruction of the cystic duct by a gallstone.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Cholangitis is infection and inflammation of the biliary tree, commonly associated with biliary obstruction, and can become a serious systemic illness.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Acute pancreatitis is sudden inflammation of the pancreas and can range from a mild self-limited illness to severe disease with organ dysfunction.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Chronic pancreatitis is persistent pancreatic inflammation that can lead to irreversible structural damage, pain, and impaired exocrine or endocrine function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Pancreatic cancer is a malignant disease of the pancreas and may present late because early symptoms can be nonspecific.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Gastrointestinal bleeding is bleeding originating anywhere in the digestive tract and may present with visible bleeding or signs of blood loss.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Upper gastrointestinal bleeding originates proximal to the ligament of Treitz and can present with hematemesis, coffee-ground vomiting, or melena.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Lower gastrointestinal bleeding generally arises from the colon, rectum, or anus and may present with hematochezia.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy allows direct visualization of the esophagus, stomach, and duodenum and can support diagnosis and selected interventions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Colonoscopy permits direct examination of the colon and terminal ileum and can support diagnosis, biopsy, surveillance, and selected therapeutic procedures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Laboratory tests used in liver assessment can provide information about hepatocellular injury, cholestasis, and hepatic synthetic function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Ultrasound is commonly used to evaluate abdominal organs and can assess the liver, gallbladder, biliary system, and other structures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Malabsorption occurs when digestion or absorption of nutrients is impaired and can lead to nutritional deficiencies and other systemic effects.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Acute abdominal pain can result from gastrointestinal, hepatobiliary, pancreatic, vascular, urinary, or other causes and may require urgent evaluation.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Healthy diet, appropriate vaccination, safe food and water practices, avoidance of tobacco, and appropriate management of chronic disease can reduce the burden of several digestive disorders.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Gastroenterology
content: Gastrointestinal care should integrate symptoms, examination, investigations, nutritional status, patient preferences, functional needs, safety, and appropriate follow-up.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.
